in_hebrew.name: Jasun
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jasun הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek and Hebrew words ‘Iaso’ (healing) and ‘Yah’ (God). Jasun symbolizes the gift of healing from God.

in_greek.name: Jasun
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God's gift
in_greek.long_meaning: Jasun είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek and Hebrew words ‘Iaso’ (healing) and ‘Yah’ (God). Jasun symbolizes the gift of healing from God.

in_latin.name: Jasun
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's gift
in_latin.long_meaning: Jasun est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Greek and Hebrew words ‘Iaso’ (healing) and ‘Yah’ (God). Jasun symbolizes the gift of healing from God.
